name: codex-figma-bridge
description: Local Codex-Figma bridge: implement the current Figma selection as code and generate structured Figma designs from natural-language intent.

interface.shortDescription: Implement Figma selections as code or generate Figma designs from intent
interface.longDescription: Local Codex-Figma bridge. A Figma Desktop plugin captures the user's live selection and ships it to a localhost bridge, which exposes it to Codex via MCP tools (get_selection, get_node, get_screenshot, get_asset, list_components). Codex can also translate natural-language product intent into a structured design that reuses components from a named Figma page, targets a named destination page, and sends it back to the plugin for one-click generation. No Figma URL or cloud connector required.
defaultPrompt: Implement my current Figma selection as a React component
Build this Figma screen in my project
Turn my Figma selection into code
Generate a Figma design for a customer revenue dashboard
